description:
## Original Description
Make SDD task evidence proven instead of self-reported. Today sdd-implement and simple-task send {command, exitCode, summary} to the workflow engine, and the engine checks only the shape and the exit-code sign for RED, GREEN, and COMPLETE transitions. An agent can record exitCode 1 or 0 without running anything, and the JEV red check classifies a summary the agent wrote. Goal: the SDD server runs the verification command itself in the project root with a timeout and an allowlist, captures the real exit code and a SHA-256 of the output, and records that observed evidence on the task transition. Self-reported evidence is rejected for tdd_required tasks once the feature is on; existing spec.json files stay readable. The RED classifier and JEV red check read the captured output instead of an agent summary. Out of scope: running arbitrary shell for other tools, changing approval gates, changing the 17-tool MCP contract shape beyond new optional inputs.

## Success Criteria
1. With the feature enabled, 100% of red, green, and verification evidence written to spec.json for tdd_required tasks carries an engine-observed exit code and a SHA-256 of captured output; a payload with a caller-supplied exitCode and no engine run is rejected with a named GovernanceError, proven by an e2e test that submits a faked exitCode. 2. Every evidence run finishes or times out within a configurable bound, default 120 s, maximum 600 s, and a timeout records a blocker instead of fabricated evidence. 3. Backward compatibility: all 12 existing .spec/specs features still load, and the existing 802 tests pass unchanged except for tests that assert the old self-reported path. 4. The RED classifier and the JEV red check receive captured stdout and stderr, bounded to 8 KB, instead of an agent-written summary.

Expected: "npm" Received: "/usr/local/bin/npm" (programName); sh/bash not rejected (port called once); childEnv keeps API_TOKEN; outputSha256 Expected 64-hex Received ""; classification Expected assertion Received ambiguous. Stub passes argv through and returns empty evidence.

Received promise resolved instead of rejected (SelfReportedEvidenceRejected); Expected observed {exitCode: 1, classification: 'assertion'} Received undefined; Expected - 7 Received + 1 (TaskTransitionInvalid details.observed missing); four evidence codes Expected passed through Received InternalError. Engine ignores run and has no mode gate yet.

Verified-mode rejection with byte-identical spec.json, engine RED/GREEN/COMPLETE entries, exit-code rule errors carrying details.observed, timeout and spawn-failed without writes, EvidenceRunnerUnavailable, self-reported compatibility, re-record RED after setup only, one run for two concurrent requests, four new codes serialized.

ESLint 0 errors (323 pre-existing warnings). tsc --noEmit passed. Tests: 205 passed, 205 total. run.argv schema with bounds and evidence-or-run anyOf; 5.5.0 shape still valid; adapter forwards run and returns evidenceMode/observed; bindEvidence wires NodeProcessAdapter, EvidenceRunner, ProcessEnvironment; JEV reads ProcessEnvironment; 17 tools; fixture regenerated for sdd-spec-impl only (32+/3-).

2.4.title: JEV red check reads the engine entry

red.summary: Tests: 3 failed, 15 passed, 18 total. Engine-red cases: Expected status answered Received skipped/not-ready because redCheck requires in-progress and caller evidence; HTTP body expectations not reached; setup entry Expected flagged ['1.1'] Received skipped. Snapshot exposes no evidence entry yet.

Engine-sourced RED: HTTP body carries the persisted excerpt and not the caller summary, sidecar binds to output_sha256, request works without caller evidence, persisted setup classification flags locally with no request, caller red at red-observed still skipped.

3.1.title: sdd-implement skill, reference, and render baseline

Expected substring: "run.argv" Received: current SKILL.md without it; Expected not to contain "Before recording, internally run the JEV `red` check" Received: present; Expected pattern /run:\s*\{\s*argv:/ in REFERENCE.md Received: old exit-code example.

SKILL.md now passes run.argv for RED/GREEN/COMPLETE, states the server runs it and records the observed exit code, moves the JEV red step after record-red, and names the setup re-record path; REFERENCE.md shows run: { argv } with no exit code; baseline refreshed for 3 sdd-implement render keys only; simple-task byte-identical.

verification.summary: Test Suites: 20 passed. Tests: 333 passed, 333 total. SKILL.md is 3990 bytes (cap 4000); canonical-assets lifecycle contract now expects run.argv, server-observed exit codes, and never-type-an-exit-code; baseline refreshed for the three sdd-implement render keys; simple-task byte-identical. 4.1.title: Stdio e2e: real run, real rejection

red.summary: Tests: 1 failed, 5 passed, 6 total. Expected pattern: /^\[output truncated: 1048576 of \d+ bytes captured\]\n/ Received string: 8 KB of 'x' with no marker. The adapter caps capture at 1 MiB and sets truncated, but the excerpt does not note the truncation (FR-5 AC2).

green.summary: Test Suites: 17 passed. Tests: 214 passed, 214 total. Packed stdio e2e: node -e exit 3 persists exit_code 3 / source engine / 64-hex hash; typed exit code rejected with SelfReportedEvidenceRejected and byte-identical spec.json; sh -c rejected with EvidenceCommandNotAllowed; self-reported server accepts the 5.5.0 shape; a 2 MiB command is capped at 1 MiB and the saved excerpt opens with '[output truncated: 1048576 of N bytes captured]'. ProcessRunResult gains totalOutputBytes.

verification.command: npx jest src/__tests__/unit/jev src/__tests__/unit/runtime && npx jest src/__tests__/unit/evidence src/__tests__/unit/workflow src/__tests__/unit/cli/governed-workflow.e2e.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint src
verification.summary: jev+runtime: 25 suites, 650 passed (JEV skill-text contract updated to the new sdd-implement wording). evidence+workflow+e2e: 17 suites, 214 passed. tsc passed. ESLint 0 errors. The e2e exposed a real FR-5 gap (excerpt did not note truncation); fixed by adding totalOutputBytes to ProcessRunResult and a '[output truncated: N of M bytes captured]' marker.

verification.command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run context:report && node scratchpad/smoke-evidence.mjs sdd-entry.js
verification.summary: ESLint 0 errors (324 warnings, 323 pre-existing). tsc passed. Build passed. npm test: 88 suites, 1475 tests passed, 0 failed (the known TTY test also passed on this run). context:report gates: codex 62.92% (>=50), omp 72.31% (>=50), claude-code 91.92% (>=60), all pass. Real artifact: the built sdd-entry.js driven over stdio with no SDD_EVIDENCE_MODE recorded a RED for a scratch feature in a temp project through run.argv: taskState red-observed, evidenceMode verified, exit_code 3, source engine, 64-hex output_sha256, red_classification assertion; the scratch project was deleted. git status shows only .spec/specs/verified-execution-evidence/ changed under .spec. Deviation: the real-artifact run used a direct stdio call to the built server, not /skill:sdd-implement, because this Claude session's MCP connection still holds the pre-change schema until it restarts.
